## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: validate-feature writes a snapshot JSON keyed by commit SHA that includes...

The system SHALL ensure that validate-feature writes a snapshot JSON keyed by commit SHA that includes every signal declared in the change's verification-signals section.

#### Scenario: validate-feature writes a snapshot JSON keyed by commit SHA that includes...

WHEN `capture-per-commit-signal-snapshots` is implemented
THEN validate-feature writes a snapshot JSON keyed by commit SHA that includes every signal declared in the change's verification-signals section.

### Requirement: gen-eval runs record snapshots in the same format, validated by a shared...

The system SHALL ensure that gen-eval runs record snapshots in the same format, validated by a shared snapshot schema.

#### Scenario: gen-eval runs record snapshots in the same format, validated by a shared...

WHEN `capture-per-commit-signal-snapshots` is implemented
THEN gen-eval runs record snapshots in the same format, validated by a shared snapshot schema.

### Requirement: The snapshot includes the default coordinator signal set even when a change...

The system SHALL ensure that the snapshot includes the default coordinator signal set even when a change declares no signals of its own.

#### Scenario: The snapshot includes the default coordinator signal set even when a change...

WHEN `capture-per-commit-signal-snapshots` is implemented
THEN The snapshot includes the default coordinator signal set even when a change declares no signals of its own.
